name: aXtn Documents
description: Document inventory and detail surface over the optional declared axtn_documents dataset.
permissions: authenticated user subject to native dataset RLS
data_contracts: optional user-owned dataset named axtn_documents; rows may provide canonical/original filename, type/family, organisation or issuer, domain, date, paths, PARA class, status, confidence, topics, source URL, MIME type, file size, modified/ingested time, and privacy class using the documented adapter aliases
known_limitations: No persistence is introduced. Without a declared dataset, the Workbench renders an empty Greenfield inventory.
AI Analyst support is pending rebinding to a native AI Analyst/data contract.
Mixed string and string-array topic contracts are intentionally not bulk editable.
